body:
V2 UI item. Inbox tab. Choice of view style.

Related: the Inboxchips item (quick filter buttons). The two items do not share a file.

## Problem
The Inbox tab only shows cards. With 354 items the homeowner cannot scan it. He wants to choose how it is shown.

## Requirements
1. A view switch at the top of the Inbox list with three views: Cards (today's view), Table, Compact list.
2. Table: one row per item with sortable columns Title, Kind, State, Age, Source, Result (first line), using the shared table component from #939 (sort, column resize, show or hide columns).
3. Compact list: one line per item (state marker, title, kind, age), result and prompt text only on expanding the row.
4. All three views show the same filtered items in the same order; the search box and the filters apply to all three.
5. The chosen view and the table columns are saved per viewer. Default on a phone is Compact list; default on desktop is Table.
6. Phone width: Table scrolls inside its own container only, Cards and Compact list never scroll sideways.
7. New module for the view switch and the renderers; dashrender.mjs, team.mjs and dashserver.mjs change by an import and one call at most.

## Acceptance
- before PR: unit tests for each renderer: an item with a long title, an item with no result, an item with an apostrophe in the title, and a waiting, a done and a failed item.
- before PR: a test that the three views list the same item ids for the same filter.
- before PR: Playwright browser test at desktop 1280 and phone 390 against a fixture inbox with the real item shapes (the done prompt "Rules drift check read only Driftcheck", the done issue_draft "Post-mortem: 3 jobs failed with cause deterministic", one waiting proposal): switches to each view, sorts the Table by Age, hides a column, reloads and the view and columns are kept, expands a Compact list row, and checks no sideways page scroll at phone width.
- before PR: the test drives the real /inbox page, not a direct call to the renderer.
- after install: Live checks below.
- before PR: docs/dashboard.md updated.

## Live checks
- GET /inbox -> 200 contains "Inbox"

## Requirements check
One row per numbered requirement above. Every row Met with file, line and the test that proves it.

## Follow-ups carried
None carried. Answer slot: if a review follow-up is raised against this item, answer it with a change, a decision or a stated reason.
